decisions: Enumerate bound function dictionary values and local descendants, select BoundFunctionKind.User, group by ModuleName, sort by Name using StringComparer.Ordinal, hash full stable identities with the canonical field hash.
Global aliases refer to the same function object. Stable identity indexing deduplicates objects, whereas emission hashing preserves dictionary entry multiplicity.
SemanticStableIdentity encodes stream Unit return, stream element type and generic stream template separately.
Implementation method identities append associated names in ordinal order and resolved stable type identities.
Build one IR node index and collect User function signatures through the shared binding and stable identity encoder.
Reuse the generic-body mask so uninstantiated generic body calls are excluded.
Retain the concrete name separately for ordinal emission ordering, and share the implementation-associated symbol ordering with declaration capture.
Group logical module fields, including multiple source indices, and hash full identity bytes with existing fingerprint arithmetic.
Reuse canonicalAliasMarker from call resolution for global alias dictionary entries; specialization records do not gain a template alias entry.
Any capture failure rejects module emission construction; partial identity inventories are diagnostics only.
